name: Rampa
subtitle: Liquid Glass navigation shell for iOS.
description: Unsigned builds of Rampa, a SwiftUI shell with a floating Liquid Glass navigation bar: five destinations, a sliding lens, and smooth motion. Install with SideStore, LiveContainer, or TrollStore.

apps.name: Rampa
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass navigation.
apps.localizedDescription:
An intentionally empty app with a navigation bar built to be looked at: five destinations inside one translucent Liquid Glass lozenge, a tinted lens that slides between them, and a short spring that keeps the whole thing fluid at 120 Hz.

Drag horizontally on the bar to slide between tabs, or tap a destination directly. Everything else is left blank on purpose, so the motion is the product.
